scope: Interactive viewer schema 1 transform composition; not Xbox mechanical calibration
derivation: For a displayed mesh M = T_n ... T_1 and edited joint j, subsequent transforms S = T_n ... T_(j+1) carry its pivot as a point and axis as a direction. Translation affects the pivot but not the axis. Dragging uses this same world frame, with other channels held fixed during the drag.
implementation: Removed with the schema-1 Casper viewer; retained here only as historical derivation evidence.
checks: Earlier X axis carried by later Z rotation becomes Y
Offset pivot follows rotation and subsequent translation
Transforms affecting other meshes are excluded
Neutral state leaves the joint frame unchanged
browser_harness: Retired schema-1 browser experiment; any old build output is historical and does not validate the current Xbox One S viewer.
limits: Numerical and synthetic browser tests, not actual controller calibration. Browser test verifies noncommuting sequential-axis interaction and pose composition, not arbitrary camera angles or simultaneous 2D dragging. No physical pivot or motion range is inferred.
